notes.title: Gamepad support
notes.content:
- Gunmancer now supports controllers
- support is specifically for Xbox controllers and steam deck
- generic gamepads and PS controllers should work too, they just won't have gamepad-specific glyphs

Hey everybody,
back with another update.

Content
[list]
[*] Dragon's breath - flamethrower shotgun - raycasting weapon with lots of bullets and a huge spread
[*] Steampunk minigun - fast shooting with bouncing rounds
[/list]

Balancing
- nerfed accuracy upgrades on shotgun

Also, I'd like to tell you that I'm working on Halloween themed in-game event that will hopefully come next Monday.

So long

notes.title: Update 1.4.1.
notes.content: - fix crashes on 2nd level because of bug on teleporting bot

Hey everybody,
back again with a biweekly update, now 4th one. Today mainly focusing on visual improvements.

Content
- new model for Gunmancer
- colour customization of Gunmancer's coat
- new weapon: toxic grenade launcher

Improvements
- better UI
- bouncing projectiles have a more realistic trajectory (concerns steampunk shotgun and disc launcher)

Bug fixes
- rooms no longer close when you enter them after killing everyone in that room

Hey everyone,

back again with a biweekly update. The main change is that now the rooms close when you enter them and remain that way until you kill all enemies there. Another change is that after death/victory you can see how many enemies you killed and how long it took you. But that's not everything there are also 2 new weapons emperor's hand (shoots lightning) and a-bomb-ination (emp), raising the total weapon count to 21 and I also hid a spear upgrade on 3rd level.

Another important update is that I started working on [url=https://gunmancer.fandom.com/wiki/Gunmancer_Wiki]Official Wiki [/url], if some of you want to help out I'd be more than glad.

And one last thing if you'd want some merch you can find it [url=https://www.redbubble.com/people/Meister351/shop]here[/url].

If you have any ideas for merch, game or otherwise feel free to leave them in the comments.


[b]SUMMARY[/b]
[list]
[*] rooms now lock until cleared
[*] timer and kill counter
[*] new weapons: emperor's hand, a-bomb-ination
[*] hidden spear upgrade
[*] wiki and merch
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
Content
- new room - incinerator (in Lab - 2nd level)
- new enemy - flame bot (spawns in incinerator) - has flamethrowers for hands
- weapons - 2 new weapons - revolver (shoots as fast as you can click) and firework launcher

Balancing
- increased enemy probability on 1st level

Bug fixes
- fixed silicon heaven achievement not unlocking
- fixed Linux version not booting up directly from steam
- fixed weapon choice UI not starting on the first weapon
- minor bug fixes
